purpose: Compare a new citizen question with an existing approved answer before investigation, identifying shared scope, material differences, reusable knowledge and fresh evidence requirements without implying that the questions or properties are equivalent.
core_principle: NEW QUESTION → EXISTING ANSWER → WHAT MATCHES → WHAT DIFFERS → WHAT CAN REUSE → WHAT MUST BE FRESH → INVESTIGATION ROUTE
rules: Same legal issue with a different property requires fresh property evidence.
Same property with a different question remains a distinct investigation scope.
Same property with a different target date requires date-specific verification.
A new legal issue cannot inherit an old conclusion merely because the property is the same.
General legal propositions may be reusable after authority/version checks.
Procedures and deadlines are revalidated when currentness matters.
Existing limitations remain attached to reused content.
The comparison does not itself establish facts or legal conclusions.
The original approved answer remains immutable.
hard_stops: Never merge different properties because of similar addresses or names.
Never merge different target dates without preserving temporal scope.
Never treat similar wording as identical legal intent.
Never copy property-specific evidence to a new property.
Never bypass the current investigation quality gate.
